card.name: Word endings in -ong and -ng
card.fires_on: The piece 'ong' (or similar 'g'/'IB') that completes a name or rare word, such as Huizong, Wollongong, Billabong, Tiangong. It fires partway through proper names and unusual words.

modes.label: Names ending in -ong
modes.description: The 'ong' piece finishing a place or personal name.

modes.label: Partway through a brand name
modes.description: A middle piece inside an unfamiliar drug brand name in dosing text.

modes.label: Chinese romanized syllables
modes.description: The final 'g' or 'ong' of a romanized Chinese name or term.

card.plain: It marks the middle of an unusual name, especially ones ending in -ong, as the word is still being spelled out.
